intent: PSI-010: add Supabase browser/server clients and a session-refresh proxy so unauthenticated dashboard visits redirect to /auth/sign-in while public endpoints are never redirected.
summary: Implemented the four files exactly per docs/frontend-architecture/supabase-clients-and-session.md: src/lib/supabase/client.ts (createBrowserClient<Database> using NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY), src/lib/supabase/server.ts (server-only createServerClient with cookies.getAll/setAll and the Server-Component refresh comment), src/lib/supabase/proxy.ts (updateSession with PUBLIC_PREFIXES covering /auth, /api/mcp, /api/calendar/feed, /api/push/dispatch, /.well-known, /sw.js, /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/; getClaims() refresh; redirect to /auth/sign-in?next=... when unauthenticated), and rewrote src/proxy.ts to call updateSession with the doc's matcher. Installed @supabase/ssr@0.12.7 + @supabase/supabase-js@2.116.0 in the frontend (they were missing). Verified: bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0, bun run lint 0 warnings/errors, bun run build exit 0 (the build prints 'ƒ Proxy (Middleware)' confirming the proxy is wired). Not yet merged — branch task/PSI-010 raised as PR.

changes.note: updateSession: getClaims refresh + PUBLIC_PREFIXES + sign-in redirect
Rewired template stub to delegate to updateSession; doc matcher

decisions.reason: The reference doc imports createBrowserClient/createServerClient from @supabase/ssr; the template had neither dependency

decisions.decision: PUBLIC_PREFIXES covers both doc-listed and accept-listed public paths
decisions.reason: accept names /api/mcp, /sw.js, /manifest.webmanifest; the reference doc expands to /auth, /api/calendar/feed, /api/push/dispatch, /.well-known, /icons/ — union satisfies both
alternatives: Only the 3 accept-listed prefixes (breaks auth pages and calendar/push feeds)

decisions.reason: Reference doc + @supabase/ssr guidance: getClaims is the recommended way to read refreshed session data without user round-trips
alternatives: getSession() then getUser() (extra network + user fetch)

verification.manual: bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0; bun run lint exit 0; bun run build exit 0. Build output shows 'ƒ Proxy (Middleware)' confirming proxy.ts is active. Runtime redirect not exercised (no running Supabase session in browser test yet).

human_review.reason: Operator ficana to review PR task/PSI-010 after merge; runtime redirect behavior to be manually verified against local Supabase.
